brand.name: BrandPulse AI
brand.voice: Confident, clear and human. We inform, we never over-promise.

rules.title: No absolute guarantees
rules.description: Absolute claims create legal exposure and break our transparency principle.

rules.title: No unverified superlatives
rules.description: Superlatives must be backed by a cited third-party source.

rules.title: Avoid hype language
rules.description: Hype words dilute credibility. Prefer concrete, specific benefits.

rules.title: Avoid pressure tactics
rules.description: Urgency language conflicts with our warm, respectful tone.
